binding.skinMeshesMeaning: GLTFLoader runtime SkinnedMesh objects, one per material primitive
binding.materialSplitExplanation: One authored mesh and one glTF mesh/skin contain two opaque material primitives. GLTFLoader creates two SkinnedMeshes sharing the same skeleton.

controller.motion: in-place; controller translates and turns Root in runtime; no embedded root translation
controller.controllerPathForQA: glTF world Z += speed * t. In native world Y -= speed * t. The planted skin sole moves opposite that path.
controller.turning: Blend or steer Root externally; never twist individual planted soles during stance
controller.runtimeParent: Translate and turn an external controller group above the animated skeleton; the skeleton Root retains its zero-based local clip transform.

Socket_ChestCore.forward: +Z local, outward from seated chest skin
Socket_ChestCore.role: Forward Equal Spark discharge; core patch is embedded and opaque

Socket_BackEmit.role: Dorsal pressure signal or burst; external effect only

Socket_Ground.role: Ground AOE reference; controller owns gameplay collision

vfx.hexSignal: External violet hex effect, owned by controller, no permanently floating crystals
vfx.equalSpark: Warm orange only in three seated material inlets
vfx.releaseAuthority: Controller uses clip times and live socket matrices, not preview lights

Stabilized.meaning: Forces fall away; still-living creature settles, then breathes. No death explosion, no captured human. Canon outcome remains Root decision.
Stabilized.afterClip: Hold settled state and repeat breath segment; do not jump back to standing Idle

attackCollision: Radius and release times are visual contracts; game damage and target selection stay with controller. No game integration performed.
